data.narrative:
Vital Lyfe is a seed-stage Climate & Energy company founded by Jonathan Criss and Andrew Harner that has raised $24M to date. The valuation universe for Climate & Energy includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers, among them Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. A targeted peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Climate & Energy cohort.

A stage-progression methodology was applied, using total capital raised ($24M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement. This approach yielded an implied valuation of $60M. The stage-progression method represents the sole quantitative anchor available given the sparse peer dataset at Vital Lyfe's specific stage and tier within the sector.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $51M to $69M, with a median point of $60M. This range reflects bounds around the single applicable methodology rather than consensus across multiple approaches. Key uncertainties include the validity of the 2.5x multiplier for this particular company's risk profile, and the absence of direct comparable transactions at the seed stage in Climate & Energy. The sparse peer universe limits confidence; a fuller comparable set would materially strengthen this analysis.
